item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In 2023, Deqin County funded five elder-care meal facilities with 1.4285 million yuan, began construction of six community elder-care service centers with total investment of 21.6 million yuan, and conducted procurement for 300 household age-adaptation renovation projects for elderly people with disabilities, functional limitations, or high support needs; construction was expected to be completed within the year.","notes":["The excerpt says bidding/procurement was completed and construction was expected, not that the 300 renovations were completed or already initiated."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Deqin County reported monthly monitoring of social-assistance eligibility, verification of death information, adjustment of assistance coverage, and checks of applicants’ household financial information under an information-sharing framework.","notes":["The excerpt supports these administrative practices, but does not clearly establish broad cross-department information sharing beyond the cited framework and coordination with a local credit union."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
